author: CC
prose: A clean rehearsal at TICKETME:waiting never carries a ticket past BUILDME. The rehearsal record hashes the whole ticket file, cursor included (rehearsal.py ticket_sha256), and the entry gate runs again on the crossing OUT of BUILDME (transitions.py: elif wf.here == 'BUILDME' and target_idx > wf.cursor -> _entry_gate). The BUILDME crossing's own cursor write changes the bytes, so buildme_rides_the_rehearsal refuses PROVEME with 'the ticket was edited after its rehearsal', and a second paid rehearsal (~$0.57, ~12 min on c62df2454322, 2026-09-24) is spent on a ticket whose decisions did not change. What the rehearsal vouches for is the decisions, not the cursor.
